notes.reason: Magic defence is +10 against +120 slash and crush. Tumeken's shadow is by far the strongest option because it receives a 4x buff from magic damage gear inside the raid.

notes.item: He only protects one style at a time
notes.reason: Akkha prays against a single style, so the meta is to bring two strong styles and swap to whichever he is not protecting. Magic-first with a ranged switch is the standard pairing.
Magic defence is -30 while stab, slash, crush and ranged are all +70, so this phase is done on magic.

name: Zebak
styleRestriction: Melee is not the play at Zebak - his crush defence is +260 and he puts out far too much damage to stand next to. A Tumeken's shadow is the strongest option, with a Bow of faerdhinen behind it, and his ranged defence of +110 is his weakest side.

name: Duke Sucellus
styleRestriction: The Duke is weak to slash and the wiki is explicit that ranged and magic are not viable alternatives here. His projectile hits up to 48 if you are not praying against it, so the fight is fought in melee range regardless.

notes.reason: Slash defence is only +45 against +255 stab and +190 crush, so a slash weapon is far ahead here.

name: The Leviathan
styleRestriction: Melee is not used at the Leviathan - his ranged defence is +50 against +260 stab, and getting into melee range only earns you his bite attack. Magic is worth bringing for shadow spells to stun him, but ranged is the damage.

name: The Whisperer
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +10 against +180 stab and +300 ranged, so this is a magic fight.

notes.reason: Magic defence is only +10 against +180 stab and +300 ranged, which is why this fight is done on magic.

name: Vardorvis
styleRestriction: Magic and ranged defence are both +580, so only melee is viable.

notes.reason: Magic and ranged defence are both +580, so only melee is viable. Slash (+65) is the weakest of the three melee styles.

Vardorvis' defence level climbs from 270 to about 360 as the fight goes on. Rankings here use the starting value. The wiki DPS calculator stores his base as 0 and applies the scaling itself, so this one value is deliberately not synced from upstream.
Every defensive bonus is +100 and she has no elemental weakness, so style choice here comes down to her high Defence and Magic levels rather than a soft spot.

notes.item: Magic defence is +298 but his Magic level is 80
notes.reason: The bonus looks huge, yet the roll is driven mostly by Magic level, so magic is not as hopeless as +298 implies - and he is 40% weak to earth.
He is a demon, so Emberlight and Arclight outperform weapons with far better raw stats. His defences are otherwise almost flat at +70 to +80.

name: Kree'arra
styleRestriction: Kree'arra flies, so melee cannot reach him. Ranged is the standard, with magic as the alternative.

notes.item: Ranged is about staying out of his melee
notes.reason: His defensive bonuses are nearly flat (+180 melee, +200 magic and ranged), so ranged is not chosen for accuracy. It is chosen because his melee is his hardest attack and distance avoids it. A Noxious halberd reaches two tiles and can hit airborne targets, so melee is viable in teams with a Soulflame horn.

name: Nex
styleRestriction: Ranged is the answer here - a Zaryte crossbow with Ruby dragon bolts (e) puts out damage nothing else matches, because the ruby proc does a flat 100 against her huge health pool. Melee works with an Osmumten's fang for its accuracy re-roll, but is not recommended. Magic is usable and clearly the weakest of the three.

notes.reason: Stab defence is +40 against +140 slash, +190 ranged and +300 magic, which is why Osmumten's fang is the melee pick rather than a scythe.

notes.item: Ranged and melee in one trip
notes.reason: Ranged dominates the Shadow phase while melee is used for Smoke, Blood and Zaros, so both setups are carried together.
Ranged defence is +50 against +200 on every other style, so the head is a ranged target. His high Magic level is also why a Twisted bow performs so well.
All melee defences are +50 against +200 magic and ranged - the opposite of the head.
Magic defence is +50 against +200 everywhere else, and its Magic level is only 87. Each part of Olm wants a different style.
Slash defence is +30 against +70 stab/crush and +230 ranged, so a scythe or other slash weapon is well ahead on this phase.
Her Magic level is 350, and Twisted bow damage scales with the target's Magic level.

name: Pestilent Bloat
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +600 and ranged +800 against slash +20. Melee only.

notes.reason: Magic defence is +600 and ranged +800 against slash +20. He is undead, so a Salve amulet (ei) applies.

notes.item: All three styles, switched to match its colour
notes.reason: The boss cycles colour and only takes damage from the matching style, so every style is carried at once. Defences are all 0 - the check is switching speed, not gear.
Magic defence is +30 against +70 melee and +150 ranged.
Ranged defence is +160 while every melee style and magic sit at 0.
Crush is +40 and ranged +40, against +170 stab, +190 slash and +400 magic.
Stab defence is -5 and ranged 0, against +82 slash and +75 magic.
Ranged defence is +50 against +315 or more on every melee style. Their health must also be kept close together or they heal.
The largest fire weakness in the raid, and fire spells are required to break its shield regardless of your gear.
Crush defence is +105 against +155 stab and +165 slash, which is why crush weapons are used here.
Both give a guaranteed defence reduction on their first hit at Tekton, so they should land before a Bandos godsword.

name: TzKal-Zuk
styleRestriction: Melee is not used in the Inferno. It is a ranged fight throughout, with a magic switch for freezing the Jads and Zuk's healers.

name: Sol Heredit
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +750 and ranged +825 against slash +5. Melee only.

notes.reason: Slash defence is +5 against magic +750 and ranged +825, so melee slash is overwhelmingly the answer.
Against +40 stab and +60 slash/ranged, magic is surprisingly competitive here despite the Sire being a classic melee target.

Crush defence is 0 against +100 stab/slash, +200 magic and +350 ranged. During the tail phase damage is also capped at 4 or 9 depending on whether crush is your highest attack bonus, so crush is doubly important.
Both forms share the same combat stats. Phase 1 runs Protect from Magic and Missiles, phase 2 runs Protect from Melee - and these only add Defence rather than blocking damage.
Crush defence is +10 against +50 stab and slash and +100 magic and ranged.
An anti-dragon shield plus an antifire potion stops his regular dragonfire outright and cuts special breaths to 10. That is worth more than any shield's combat stats here.
Stab defence is +40 against +90 slash and crush.
She only attacks with melee, so the prayer removes all damage and defensive gear stops mattering. Dharok's is a standard approach precisely because you can afford to sit at low health.
Between 50% and 5% health she can burrow away on each of your attacks. Poison damage does not trigger it.

name: Thermonuclear smoke devil
styleRestriction: Magic is how this is done. A Trident of the swamp outranges an Eye of ayak, and that extra reach is the point - it lets you attack without being hit back. Freezing spells hold the smoke devils in place while you work.

notes.reason: Magic defence is +800 and ranged +900 against slash +4. Nothing but melee is viable, whatever the elemental weakness suggests.
You cannot damage it at all below 93 Slayer, and boosts do not count.

name: Scorpia
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +44 against +246 stab and +284 everywhere else. Scorpia is a magic fight.

notes.reason: Magic defence is +44 against +246 stab and +284 everything else, and her Magic level is 1. This is a magic fight despite looking like a melee boss.

notes.item: Wilderness - bring gear you can lose
notes.reason: Multi-combat zone above level 50 Wilderness, so player killers can attack at any time.
Two guardians spawn and heal her rapidly at close range, which favours killing her quickly over out-sustaining her.
They switch protection prayers to your last used style after taking enough damage, so a single-style setup stalls out. This is a fight where the correct answer is two loadouts, not one best item.
Their fire shield cuts non-demonbane damage by 20% until it is knocked down, so a demonbane weapon effectively gains 20% that no stat line shows.
Against +175 slash and +150 ranged, magic is the standout style here - and they are 30% weak to water on top.
Skotizo is a demon and takes heavily increased demonbane damage, which puts Arclight ahead of weapons with far better raw stats.
Crush defence is +10 against +60 stab, +150 magic and +300 ranged. There is also a combat achievement for killing her with crush.

notes.item: Fire weakness does not make magic good
notes.reason: She is 40% weak to fire, but +150 magic defence still makes maging her inefficient. Weakness and defence have to be read together.
Fully negate her web-binding immobilisation - useful for comfort rather than damage.
Crush defence is +60 against +300 stab and slash, so crush is far and away the melee option.
Unusually, spell element does not matter here - pick a staff on raw damage instead.
Takes full poison damage normally, but gains 100% poison and venom resistance while shielded and also becomes immune to thralls. Demonbane weapons carry the shielded phase.

Jad has no defensive bonuses at all, so gear choice is about avoiding his attacks rather than beating his defence. Ranging him from distance removes the melee attack entirely, leaving only magic and ranged to pray against.
Crush defence is 0 against +12 stab/slash and +700 magic and ranged, so melee crush is the obvious route.
Despite +700 ranged defence, your ranged accuracy is multiplied by 6 whenever Eldric is out of melee distance - a mechanic that completely inverts what his stat block implies.
Identical stat block to Eldric - crush defence 0, magic and ranged +700.
Branda and Eldric have the same defensive stats but opposite elemental weaknesses. Stats alone cannot tell them apart.
She can disable prayers before attacking, and ground hazards deal typeless damage that protection prayers cannot reduce.
Scurrius uses all three attack styles and is designed to teach fast prayer switching, so coverage matters more than specialising.

name: Blood Moon
styleRestriction: Ranged and magic defence are both +500 against +0 slash. This is a melee fight, and slash is the attack type you want.

notes.reason: Slash defence is 0 against +100 stab and crush, and +500 on both magic and ranged. Each of the three Moons has the same +500 magic and ranged wall but a different melee gap - Blood wants slash, Blue wants crush, Eclipse wants stab.

notes.item: She heals from her three-hit attack
notes.reason: Her series of three hits heals her based on damage dealt, so killing speed matters more than raw sustain.

name: Blue Moon
styleRestriction: Ranged and magic defence are both +500 against +0 crush. This is a melee fight, and crush is the attack type you want.

notes.reason: Crush defence is 0 against +100 stab and slash. Its negative flat armour also makes multi-hit weapons unusually effective.

name: Eclipse Moon
styleRestriction: Ranged and magic defence are both +500 against +0 stab. This is a melee fight, and stab is the attack type you want.

notes.reason: Stab defence is 0 against +100 slash and crush.
During the Clone special, ranged and magic deal no damage at all - only melee works.
Slash defence is +20 against +60 stab and crush.
The largest elemental weakness in the game - fire spells are twice as effective for both accuracy and damage, which makes magic genuinely viable for players without strong melee.
Magic defence is +30 and its Magic level only 60, against +150 or more on every other style. Strong melee defences make it look like a melee target when it is not.
It is a golem, so golembane weapons deal bonus damage that no stat line shows.
Crush defence is +20 against +40 stab, +60 slash, +165 magic and +175 ranged.

notes.item: Protect from Melee cuts its max hit from 31 to 5
notes.reason: Prayer matters far more than defensive gear here.

name: Deranged archaeologist
styleRestriction: Magic is the answer here despite his +300 magic defence bonus, because his Magic level is negligible and the roll is what actually matters. Fighting from a distance also stops him meleeing you at all, so you can pray Ranged and take nothing.

notes.reason: The wiki states it directly: an NPC's magic defence is calculated off its Magic level, not its Defence level - and his Magic level is 1. Another case where a defensive bonus read alone is misleading.
Both are +20 against +50 crush.

name: Chaos Fanatic
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +50 against +250 crush and +280 magic. Range him.

notes.reason: Standard ranged defence is +50 against +250 or more on every melee style and +280 magic. Protect from Magic also negates his main attack entirely.
A full inventory negates his disarm special attack completely.

name: Crazy archaeologist
styleRestriction: Magic and ranged defence are both +250 against +5 stab and slash. Melee only.

notes.reason: Magic defence rolls mostly off the target's Magic level, and his is 1. The +250 bonus looks prohibitive but is not - a good example of why a defensive bonus cannot be read on its own.
Stab and slash defence are both +5, against +30 crush.
Magic defence is +101 against +188 or more on melee and +231 ranged, and its Defence level is only 90.

name: Artio
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +40 and magic defence is +0, against +125 stab. Same as Callisto - do not melee her.

notes.reason: Weaker and safer - his melee minimum hit is 15 rather than Callisto's 35. Magic defence is 0 and ranged only +40.

name: Callisto
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +50 and magic defence is +0, against +150 stab - and his melee hits far too hard to stand in. Range or mage him.

notes.item: Bring gear you can afford to lose
notes.reason: Multi-way Wilderness. Ranged defence is only +50 and magic defence 0, against +125 or more on every melee style, so fighting from distance is both safer and more accurate.

name: Calvar'ion
styleRestriction: Crush defence is -10 against +198 magic and +211 ranged. Crush melee, and nothing else.

notes.reason: Quicker and safer for lower loot. Crush defence is -10, same as Vet'ion, so crush weapons remain the answer.

name: Spindel
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +205 against +10 crush. Crush melee is the answer, with ranged as a slower alternative.

notes.reason: Easier and safer for lower drop rates. Crush defence is +10 against +70 stab and slash, so crush again.

name: Venenatis
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +300 against +10 crush. Crush melee is the answer, with ranged as a slower alternative.

notes.reason: Crush defence is +10 against +100 stab and slash, +300 magic and +150 ranged. The 40% fire weakness does not overcome that magic defence.

Its Madness attack removes up to four equipped items mid-fight, so expect to re-equip. Defences are a flat +70 across every style, meaning gear choice here is about handling that mechanic rather than beating a weakness.
Venom-inflicting weapons only apply poison here, so their usual advantage is reduced.

name: Vet'ion
styleRestriction: His crush defence is -10 against +250 magic and +270 ranged. Crush melee, and nothing else.

notes.item: Bring gear you can afford to lose
notes.reason: This is a Wilderness boss in a multicombat area. The recommended setup is deliberately cheaper than your best gear - a few high-strength pieces and budget filler, or Trouver parchments on anything valuable.
Vet'ion's crush defence is -10, so crush weapons hit him easily despite his otherwise high defences.

name: Yama
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +220 against +0 magic and +80 slash. Yama is a demon, so demonbane gear applies - the Purging staff above all.

notes.reason: Yama is a demon and takes 120% demonbane damage, so Emberlight and Arclight beat higher-stat weapons outright.
Yama changes his combat stance based on what you last hit him with, so a single fixed ranking cannot describe the whole fight.

name: Dagannoth Prime
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +10 against +255 on every other style.

notes.reason: Ranged defence is +10 against +255 on every other style. The three Kings each have exactly one viable style, which is the whole point of the fight.

name: Dagannoth Rex
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +10 and Magic level 0, against +255 on every other style.

notes.reason: Magic defence is +10 and his Magic level is 0, against +255 on every other style. This is the clearest example in the game of a boss that looks like a melee target and is not.

name: Dagannoth Supreme
styleRestriction: All melee defences are +10 against +255 magic and +550 ranged.

notes.reason: All melee defences are +10 against +255 magic and +550 ranged.
Dusk's armour protects him from both magic and ranged entirely, so melee is mandatory on him regardless of stats.

name: Araxxor
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +237 against +15 crush. Crush melee is the fight, with ranged as the alternative.

notes.reason: Crush defence is +15 against +160 stab, +237 magic and +218 ranged, which is why Inquisitor's gear ranks above Torva here.
Crush defence is +25 against +50 stab and +100 slash, which supports Inquisitor's gear and a crush weapon here.

name: Corporeal Beast
styleRestriction: Damage is halved unless you use a corpbane weapon on stab, so melee is the only real option.

notes.reason: The Corporeal Beast halves damage from any weapon that is not a spear or halberd, which outweighs raw stat comparisons.

name: Phantom Muspah
styleRestriction: Melee is not used here. Ranged defence is +56 against +185 stab, and the fight alternates between a ranged and a magic phase.

forms.name: Ranged form
forms.note: Ranged defence is only +56 here, so this is the ranged window.

forms.name: Melee form
forms.note: Magic defence collapses to +34 while ranged climbs to +261 - switch to magic.

notes.item: Both styles go in one inventory
notes.reason: This is a switch fight, not a choice. The melee form drops magic defence to +34 while ranged rises to +261; the ranged form is the exact reverse. You need magic and ranged gear on the same trip.

notes.item: 65% weak to air, but +437 magic defence on the ranged form
notes.reason: The largest elemental weakness in the game sits behind very high magic defence for part of the fight, which is why the weakness alone does not make it a pure magic kill.

name: Phosani's Nightmare
styleRestriction: Magic and ranged defence are both +600 against +40 crush. This is a melee fight - crush weapons only.

notes.item: Praying correctly blocks her damage entirely
notes.reason: Unlike the normal Nightmare, correct prayers fully block her attacks, so the fight is a prayer-flick check rather than a gear check.
Crush defence is +40 against +120 stab, +180 slash and +600 on magic and ranged. Crush also guarantees max hits on husks and weakened parasites.
Salve amulet does nothing here.

name: The Nightmare
styleRestriction: Magic and ranged defence are both +600 against +40 crush. This is a melee fight - crush weapons only.

notes.reason: Salve amulet has no effect here, despite being an obvious pick on stats alone.
Crush defence is +40 against +120 stab, +180 slash and +600 on both magic and ranged. Melee crush is effectively the only option.

name: Kraken
styleRestriction: Ranged defence is +300 and Defence level is 1, so magic is overwhelmingly the fastest option.

notes.reason: Ranged defence is +300 and defence level is 1, so magic is overwhelmingly the fastest option.

name: Vorkath
styleRestriction: Magic defence is +240 against +26 stab and +26 ranged. Vorkath is a dragon, so dragonbane weapons - the Dragon hunter lance or crossbow - carry the fight.

notes.reason: Against +108 slash/crush and +240 magic, stab melee and ranged are the two viable routes - which is why Dragon hunter lance and Dragon hunter crossbow lead their tables.

forms.name: Serpentine (green)
forms.note: Magic defence is negative here, so this is the magic window.

forms.name: Magma (red)
forms.note: Ranged defence jumps to +300 - mage this one.

forms.name: Tanzanite (blue)
forms.note: The mirror image - magic defence +300, ranged 0, so range this one.

notes.reason: All three forms share the same Defence level, but magic defence swings from -45 to +300 and ranged from 0 to +300 between them. Ranged and magic are the standard pairing; melee is a viable alternative route rather than a required switch.
Venom immunity frees the inventory slot an anti-venom+ would take. It is a DPS loss versus a best-in-slot helm, so it is a trade rather than an upgrade.
Zulrah has a 50% elemental weakness to fire, so fire spells perform unusually well here.
